pandas.concat

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Stack pandas objects along rows or place them side by side. Use axis=1 for columns and ignore_index=True to renumber the combined axis.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example

Call syntax

pd.concat(…) Full signature
pd.concat(
    objs,
    *,
    axis=0,
    join='outer',
    ignore_index=False,
    keys=None,
    levels=None,
    names=None,
    verify_integrity=False,
    sort=…,
    copy=…,
    union_categories=False,
)

ParameterRequirementAccepted values and behavior
objs
      Required

      an iterable or mapping of Series or DataFrame objects
Pass a sequence or a mapping of Series and DataFrames to combine.


axis
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 0		
      {0/'index', 1/'columns'}
Use 0 to stack rows and 1 to put columns next to each other.


join
      Optional
Keyword only
Default 'outer'		
      {'inner', 'outer'}
Choose "outer" to retain all labels on the other axis or "inner" to retain only shared labels.


ignore_index
      Optional
Keyword only
Default False		
      bool
Give the resulting axis new integer labels where supported.
